column3: Kept visible on purpose. Vercel adds Access-Control-Allow-Origin * to STATIC files only (HTML, JS, CSS, robots.txt); the API (/api/v1/*) does not send it. A * origin can never carry cookies, and these files are public anyway.
False positive: 2080374784 in the minified bundle is a bit mask (0x7C000000), not a time.
False positive: the word "from" inside a library comment in the minified bundle; no internal information.
Intended: index.html is "public, max-age=0, must-revalidate" so a new deploy shows at once; hashed assets are cacheable by design.
Intended: Vercel's CDN serves the public static files from its cache (Age header); no private data is cached.
Informational only: tells ZAP the site is a JavaScript application.
